These caller-controlled values were interpolated directly into shell command strings executed via `child_process.execSync()`, which runs commands through `/bin/sh`.  A crafted value such as `baseBranch = "main; <arbitrary command> #"` (or a `$(...)` command substitution, or a `folderPath` that breaks out of the surrounding quotes) results in **arbitrary command execution** on the host running the MCP server.  ### Patc ;; REFS: https://github.com/Orcus2021/code-review-mcp-server/security/advisories/GHSA-jq3q-62jc-fqq9 https://github.com/Orcus2021/code-review-mcp-server/issues/56 https://github.com/Orcus2021/code-review-mcp-server/pull/57 https://github.com/Orcus2021/code-review-mcp-server/commit/d11642322b607556affaaa3fd631d4f8942c05d8 https://github.com/Orcus2021/code-review-mcp-server https://github.com/Orcus2021/code-review-mcp-server/releases/tag/v1.5.3

candidates.description: REBUILD 4.5.0 through 4.5.4 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows low-privileged authenticated users to recover the administrator password hash by filtering User.password through the MCP QueryRecords tool. Attackers can send LK2 prefix-match filters to the /gw/mcp/sse gateway and use the returned total count as an oracle to extract the SHA-256 hash one character at a time, then log in as administrator.

candidates.description: RedAmon before 7.8.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the kali-sandbox terminal server that allows unauthenticated attackers to obtain a root shell by connecting to its WebSocket listener on port 8016. Attackers who can reach the port from co-resident containers or the host loopback can send keystrokes to an interactive /bin/bash session, executing commands as root inside the kali-sandbox container.

candidates.description: Contentlayer @contentlayer/core through 0.3.4 contains a code injection vulnerability that allows attackers to inject JavaScript by embedding single quotes in content file names. Attackers can add a content file whose name breaks out of the import specifier in makeDataExportFile(), executing injected code when contentlayer dev or a Next.js dev server imports the generated module.
